notes.title: Release Schmelease
notes.notes:
[p]Hello fellow Slingerinos,[/p][p]
after all over more than 4 years of prototyping, brainstorming, developing and discarding many many options Sling-A-Thing could have become - we are very proud, tired, exhausted to finally release our brand new game today![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779634/d9a3a0ac34ef78f660a445a42f5685af77d44241.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for all of you to support us on the way - no matter whether it was through playtesting, kind words, lighthearted kick up the backsides or even contract work so we could even work on such a project.[/p][p]Have fun slinging you way through all our hand-crafted levels, achieve the challenges we put together and - what matters the most: enjoy the quirkiness![/p][p][/p][p]Tschüsseldorf, Thomas & Fabian[/p]

notes.title: Sling a Feature
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello Slinger[/h1][/b]
Welcome to our very first Sling-A-Thing Demo Update!

First and foremost, [b]many thanks[/b] for your interest in our game. We really hope you have fun playing it. The past days were exciting. We received valuable feedback and heartwarming words.

[h2]Whats in this Update?[/h2]
[list]
[*] More languages!
[*] More visual feedback for all items
[*] We rearranged some levels to be more coherent
[*] A new UI icon to show the current Star-Challenge progress were implemented
[*] Some smaller bugs at the end of the Demo were fixed
[/list]

Stay tuned 🍎
Fabian and Thomas
Navel
